ai.title: Add Claude Code comparison docs and MarkdownTable component
ai.summary: New `web/src/content/advanced/claude-code-comparison.mdx` provides a feature matrix comparing Codebuff to Claude Code. `web/src/components/docs/mdx/markdown-table.tsx` implements a client-side parser for rendering these tables with copy-to-clipboard support. `web/src/app/docs/[category]/page.tsx` registers the new component in the MDX dynamic imports. `web/src/app/subscription/confirm/page.tsx` refactors error handling to display a specific toast for unpaid invoices linking to the Stripe customer portal.

eli5.text: The documentation site now shows a side-by-side comparison of Codebuff and Claude Code using a new table format that lets visitors copy feature details to their clipboard with a click. Visitors reading the advanced docs will see this comparison page, while subscribers who hit a payment issue during an upgrade now get a clear message about unpaid invoices with a direct link to pay them, instead of a generic error. These changes are live on the docs and subscription confirmation pages today.
